repositories.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repositories.description_zh: 一个运行在浏览器里的侦察卫星模拟器，使用真实开源空间情报数据，在逼真的 3D 地球上展示实时态势。

repositories.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
repositories.description_zh: PyTorch 是 Python 深度学习框架，提供张量计算、动态图神经网络和强 GPU 加速能力。
AirLLM 支持在单张 4GB GPU 上运行 70B 模型推理，适合低显存大模型部署和推理优化场景。

repositories.description: Original Apollo 11 Guidance Computer (AGC) source code for the command and lunar modules.
repositories.description_zh: Apollo 11 Guidance Computer 的原始源代码归档，包含指令舱和登月舱相关 AGC 汇编代码。

repositories.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
repositories.description_zh: dsh 插件，免登录、免注册、免 API Key 使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 等前沿模型，且免费不限量。

repositories.description: VectorCraft: An open-source, vector art tool written by scratch in pure Rust
repositories.description_zh: VectorCraft 是用纯 Rust 从零编写的开源矢量绘图工具。

repositories.description: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
repositories.description_zh: 让 Claude Code 面向任意 PC 游戏做 mod 的工具集，覆盖侦察、逆向、fal 生成美术/3D/音频、游戏内测试和展示视频。

repositories.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repositories.description_zh: 用 agents 逆向分析各类目标，从应用行为到原生二进制都能覆盖。

repositories.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
repositories.description_zh: 用于将 PS5 可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的工具。

repositories.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
repositories.description_zh: ArtCraft 是面向艺术家、设计师和电影创作者的可控创作引擎。
